question_bank.stem: A team wants to explore an AI-assisted product idea quickly without touching production data or exposing users. Which workflow best matches the lecture's advice?

options.text: Integrate with legacy systems first, because realistic prototypes need production dependencies from day one.
Deploy directly to real users, because faster safety learning comes from skipping sandboxes.
Build a sandboxed prototype locally, move fast, and use failures to guide the next iteration.
Avoid quick prototypes, because discarded proofs of concept usually signal wasted effort rather than useful learning.

question_bank.rationale: Ng argues for fast prototype cycles inside sandboxes or local setups, then learning from what breaks before anything production-facing.
